subject: checkout-web 9.3.0 release failed
body: Heads-up from the storefront release: the 9.3.0 canary was aborted at 25% after readiness failures. Two pods are in CrashLoopBackOff and we're down to 6 of 8 ready. Looks like the new address API host doesn't resolve. Stable 9.2.2 is still serving traffic but capacity is reduced. Can someone from platform confirm the DNS entry? I'd like to retry the release this week.
